A '''micro-processor''' was used in [[Kamperdine Clothing Specialists/Legends|Kamperdine Clothing Specialists]] [[Body glove/Legends|body gloves]]. They collected data from [[feedback sensor]]s in the clothing and then regulated the body glove's systems to keep the wearer comfortable.
